payout_quote: Business Essentials: $400 bonus with $5,000 deposits and daily balance. Platinum Business Checking: $1,200 bonus with $25,000 deposits and daily balance.
steps: Open a new U.S. Bank Business Essentials or Platinum Business Checking account between 7/01/2026 and 9/27/2026 with promo code Q3DIG26 (auto-applied online); $25 minimum opening deposit.
Deposit at least $5,000 (Essentials) or $25,000 (Platinum) in new money from outside U.S. Bank within 30 days of account opening.

Maintain at least that same daily balance through the 60th day after opening and complete 6 qualifying transactions (debit purchases, ACH, wire, Zelle, mobile check deposit, checks, business bill pay) within 60 days.
Bonus is deposited into the new business checking account within 30 days after the month-end in which all requirements are met, provided the account stays open with a positive balance.
catches: Promo code Q3DIG26 must be used at account opening; limit one bonus per business; existing businesses with a business checking account now or closed within the past 12 months do not qualify.
New money only: funds from outside U.S. Bank; transfers from another U.S. Bank product or affiliate do not count.
Balance must be maintained daily through day 60; account fees may reduce the balance during the qualifying period and kill eligibility.
6 qualifying transactions required within 60 days (P2P payments, credit-card transfers, and transfers between U.S. Bank accounts do not count).

Platinum account carries a $30 monthly maintenance fee unless waived ($25,000 average collected checking balance, payment solutions, or $75,000 combined balances); fee drag reduces net bonus if not waived.
Offer valid only 7/01/2026-9/27/2026; offer may be withdrawn at any time without notice; cannot be combined with other business checking bonus offers.
Bonus is reported as interest on IRS Form 1099-INT; recipient pays any applicable taxes. U.S. Bank employees excluded.
biggest_catch: The headline $1,200 tier requires parking $25,000 of outside money for 60 days plus 6 qualifying transactions; the $30/month Platinum fee eats into the bonus unless the $25,000 balance (or other waiver) is maintained. Only new-to-U.S.-Bank businesses qualify, one bonus per business, offer ends 9/27/2026.
eligibility: New U.S. Bank business checking customers only; one bonus per business; no current business checking account and none closed within the past 12 months.
timing: Open 7/01/2026-9/27/2026; deposit new money within 30 days; maintain daily balance through day 60; 6 qualifying transactions within 60 days; bonus paid within 30 days after the month-end in which requirements are met.
